Ten-part evaluation

CAM builds movements → checks → simulation pass/fail → timing judge. Only passing plans qualify. The judge accepts the time or asks CAM to try again.

Actual simulation recordings

Recorded tool positions and nominal voxel stock removal. Each video is time-scaled to ten seconds; the on-screen clock shows simulated time. These videos show workpiece machining, not physical operation of the downloaded Haas.
